set.body:
Scope new semantic fingerprints by applicable code, data and rule versions while retaining the historical identity encodings.

Acceptance criteria

1. Changing only a processing-runner input leaves new archival interpretations identical. Changing an applicable archive rule changes its fingerprint and follows the ordinary review path.
2. Existing recorded release, manifest, interpretation and assessment IDs still verify against the historical corpus. A change in meaning is surfaced for reassessment before a dependent edit.
3. Add build-level differential fixtures showing the effects of an unrelated change, a relevant change and a legacy read. Document the fingerprint inputs so another maintainer can reproduce them.

Verification

Two controlled build variations plus the historical-upgrade oracle and an existing-dataset edit/reassessment test.

Source: docs/architecture-assessment-2026-11-18.md (b82cd14).
set.title: PRO02: Isolate interpretation fingerprints to the rules that affect a profile
